scope.coverage_note: Operations shared by multiple reports are logged once. The assignments' source opening and publication checks were generally abstract or full-text, not just search snippets.

operations.query: site:proceedings.neurips.cc Tree of Thoughts Deliberate Problem Solving 2023 PDF

sources.title: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models
sources.status: Peer-reviewed NeurIPS 2023 main-conference paper; official proceedings result verified.
sources.access: Official abstract page and relevant full-text PDF passages were returned by the search operation; PDF was not separately opened.
sources.support_checked: The framework explores/evaluates candidate reasoning paths; experiments concern Game of 24, creative writing and Mini Crosswords. Retrieved paper passages note added resource cost and narrow task coverage.

sources.title: CodeAgent: Enhancing Code Generation with Tool-Integrated Agent Systems for Real-World Repo-level Coding Challenges
sources.status: Peer-reviewed ACL 2024 long paper; ACL Anthology record verifies proceedings, DOI and pages.
sources.support_checked: Abstract describes artifact retrieval, implementation and testing tools and reports CodAgentBench pass-rate gains of 2.0–15.8 points.

sources.title: Can Language Models Replace Programmers for Coding? REPOCOD Says ‘Not Yet’
sources.status: Peer-reviewed ACL 2025 long paper; ACL Anthology record verifies proceedings and bibliographic data.
sources.support_checked: Abstract reports 980 whole-function tasks across 11 projects, <30% pass@1 for each of ten models, and retrieval-augmented context outperforming target-function dependency context.

sources.title: Optimizing Instructions and Demonstrations for Multi-Stage Language Model Programs
sources.status: Peer-reviewed EMNLP 2024 paper; ACL Anthology record verifies venue and pages.
sources.support_checked: Abstract describes prompt optimization against a downstream metric, task-grounded proposals and mini-batch surrogate evaluation; it reports improvements on five of seven programs, up to 13% accuracy, with Llama-3-8B.

sources.title: Language Models can Solve Computer Tasks
sources.status: Peer-reviewed NeurIPS 2023 main-conference paper; official record verified.
sources.support_checked: Abstract describes Recursive Criticizes and Improves (RCI) and MiniWoB++ results. It does not establish that self-critique independently verifies factual/source claims.

sources.title: ResearchAgent: Iterative Research Idea Generation over Scientific Literature with Large Language Models
sources.status: Peer-reviewed NAACL-HLT 2025 long paper; ACL Anthology record verifies proceedings, DOI and pages.
sources.support_checked: Abstract supports academic graph and concept retrieval, idea/method/experiment generation, iterative LLM reviewing, and evaluation across disciplines. It is not repository investigation evidence.

sources.title: Should we be going MAD? A Look at Multi-Agent Debate Strategies for LLMs
sources.status: Peer-reviewed ICML 2024 paper; PMLR proceedings record verified.
sources.access: Abstract and metadata; paper PDF unavailable through the original report's route, and not required for the abstract-level claim.
sources.support_checked: Abstract says debate did not reliably outperform self-consistency/ensembles without tuning, while some tuned systems performed better and the protocols were settings-sensitive.

sources.title: Pride and Prejudice: LLM Amplifies Self-Bias in Self-Refinement
sources.status: Peer-reviewed ACL 2024 long paper; ACL Anthology record verifies proceedings and pages.
sources.support_checked: Abstract reports self-bias across six models and translation, constrained-generation and math tasks; self-refinement can improve fluency while amplify bias, and accurate external feedback can reduce it.

sources.title: Demystifying LLM-Based Software Engineering Agents
sources.status: Peer-reviewed FSE 2025 research paper; PDF gives Proc. ACM Softw. Eng. citation/DOI and official FSE research-papers track page was opened.
sources.support_checked: Abstract and cited sections describe the Agentless localization/repair/validation pipeline, benchmark results, filtering of inadequate or misleading descriptions, and external-validity limitations. The original r612 report's relevant full-paper open was operation 12; validity-limit search was operation 17, after its allowed first 16 operations.

sources.title: Synthesizing scientific literature with retrieval-augmented language models
sources.status: Published Nature journal article, published 4 February 2026; Nature page verifies journal volume/pages and open access.
sources.support_checked: Abstract and article describe OpenScholar's specialized 45-million-paper store, passage retrieval, citation-backed synthesis and self-feedback; benchmark and human-evaluation claims are in the article. Transfer is limited to its specialized scholarly QA task setting.

sources.title: LiRA: A Multi-Agent Framework for Reliable and Readable Literature Review Generation
sources.status: Published AAAI proceedings paper; AAAI page gives DOI, date, volume, issue and pages.
sources.access: Abstract and metadata; full PDF not inspected.
sources.support_checked: Abstract describes specialized outline/writing/edit/review agents and reports writing/citation-quality results on literature-review datasets. This is not evidence on software architecture decisions.

sources.title: ContextBench: A Benchmark for Context Retrieval in Coding Agents
sources.status: arXiv preprint; accessed record provides no peer-reviewed venue, so publication status is unknown.
sources.support_checked: Paper describes issue-resolution context retrieval on 1,136 tasks/66 repositories/eight languages; it reports broad-recall/noisy retrieval, explored-versus-utilized gaps and marginal retrieval gains from more elaborate scaffolding. It evaluates coding issue resolution, not architecture-research scouts.

sources.title: Evaluating AGENTS.md: Are Repository-Level Context Files Helpful for Coding Agents?
sources.status: arXiv v3 preprint dated 29 September 2026; accessed record provides no peer-reviewed venue, so publication status is unknown.
sources.support_checked: Abstract and full text support no general task-success improvement for supplied context files, average inference-cost increase over 20%, and lack of helpfulness for repository overviews; they also distinguish developer-committed context files from LLM-generated ones and identify special conventions as a possible use.

case_results.operation_limit_status: within case cap; 5 assigned verification operations plus shared sources

findings.caveat: The three benchmark tasks are not repository research or architecture decisions; the paper explicitly notes cost and narrow task coverage.
findings.reason: A bounded branch/evidence/discriminator prompt is a supported experiment design; it is not evidence of transfer success.

findings.caveat: Both results concern code generation/retrieval benchmarks; CodeAgent's reported gains and RepoCod's retrieval comparison do not test architecture scouting or current models.
findings.reason: The narrow recommendation to cite repository artifacts and check relevant context is supported as a testable workflow implication; no prompt superiority is established.

findings.caveat: MIPRO optimizes LM-program task metrics; it does not establish quality for open research or mixed-model software decisions.
findings.reason: The claim is limited to treating a prompt change as a measurable hypothesis, consistent with the reported downstream-metric optimization.

findings.caveat: The RCI abstract reports computer-task and reasoning results but says nothing about source verification; the independent-verification caution is not a paper result.
findings.reason: Qualified only as a proposal to use critique to surface checks while independently verifying sources; no empirical support is claimed for that governance practice.

case_results.omissions_and_errors: No publication-label error found in sampled sources. None directly evaluates Luna repository scouts, architecture alternatives, prompt injection, or mixed-model handoff. RCI's source does not substantiate the independent-verification recommendation; that is a process inference, not a finding from the cited paper.

case_results.operation_limit_status: original exceeded cap: 18 total operations (8 searches, 7 opens, 3 finds); policy allows first 16 total / 8 searches / 10 opens. Operations 17 and 18 are excluded from support decisions. Findings relying on evidence first surfaced by those operations are unresolved.

findings.caveat: ResearchAgent generates scientific research ideas from literature and uses collaborative LLM review; it does not test repository exploration or a smaller model with expert handoff.
findings.reason: The research/review workflow description is supported at abstract level and can motivate a local matched experiment only.

findings.caveat: Benchmark questions and evaluated systems differ from architecture investigation and Luna; full method appraisal remains unavailable.
findings.reason: The bounded conclusion that debate is not a dependable default is stated in the source abstract; a local test remains required.

findings.caveat: Studied tasks are translation, constrained generation and math reasoning, not software architecture or prompt-injection handling.
findings.reason: The narrow warning about self-feedback bias and need for accurate external assessment is supported by the abstract.

findings.claim_support: direct full for pipeline/results; unresolved for the external-validity clause under the original operation cutoff
findings.caveat: The original full PDF was opened within operation 12 and filtering results were surfaced at operation 16. The report's Threats to Validity evidence was first found at operation 17, outside the permitted first-16 window; thus its claim about stated external-validity limits cannot count as verified for this evaluation. Agentless remains issue repair, not architecture scouting.
findings.reason: The core simple-pipeline and benchmark statements are supported, but the submitted finding includes a consequential external-validity claim whose supporting check is over budget. Keep the full finding and unresolved upper-bound credit.

case_results.omissions_and_errors: The overrun is a process-contract violation, not a factual source error. Preserve it and the original report's full findings. Do not treat post-operation-16 checks as evidence for acceptance.

case_results.operation_limit_status: within case cap; 6 assigned verification operations plus shared MAD source

findings.caveat: General benchmark debate strategies do not establish useful software architecture critique or model-tier transfer.
findings.reason: Use only as a caution against assuming debate helps and as rationale for a small matched local comparison.

findings.caveat: OpenScholar is a specialized scholarly retrieval/synthesis system evaluated on literature QA benchmarks; it does not establish that iterations always help or validate repository-scoped claims.
findings.reason: Passage retrieval, attribution and citation evaluation are direct elements/results of this system; applicability is limited to experimental design for the task.

findings.caveat: The abstract's domain is systematic literature-review production, not architecture decisions or heterogeneous model coordination; no cost or patch-acceptance result.
findings.reason: Role specialization is reported in a separate synthesis domain and can motivate, but not validate, disjoint evidence assignments.

findings.caveat: Preprint status only; evaluates repository issue-resolution context retrieval with frontier models, not architecture-alternative discovery by lower-tier scouts.
findings.reason: Full text supports context precision/recall/efficiency and explored-versus-used gaps; recommendation is to locally evaluate decision-relevant evidence use.

findings.caveat: It studies issue-fixing success and cost rather than investigation quality; developer-written and generated context differ, and the result does not justify removing useful local practice instructions.
findings.reason: Full paper supports the bounded warning that context files/overviews are not guaranteed to improve task success and can add cost; original report notes exceptions/uncertainty.

case_results.omissions_and_errors: No publication-label error found. ContextBench and AGENTS.md are correctly treated as preprints with peer-review status unknown. No paper directly validates mixed-model architecture handoffs, prompt-injection protection, direct expert source access, timely review, or independent patch acceptance.

deduplicated_union.mechanism: bounded candidate search / explicit alternative evaluation
deduplicated_union.distinct_decision_implication: Request a small set of genuinely different options, evidence for and against, and a discriminating check; evaluate cost and transfer locally.

deduplicated_union.mechanism: repository artifact retrieval and evaluation of relevant context
deduplicated_union.distinct_decision_implication: Cite concrete repository evidence and assess relevance/use rather than report length or broad context volume.
Compare a defined prompt change against a baseline on matched tasks and score task quality, not verbosity.
Use critique to surface assumptions, but inspect cited evidence independently; self-bias evidence supports the caution, while RCI does not establish source verification.

deduplicated_union.mechanism: research workflow with retrieval, candidate generation and iterative external review
deduplicated_union.distinct_decision_implication: Use compact cited evidence and targeted distinct roles as a testable workflow; scholarly ideation/synthesis papers do not validate repository architecture transfer.

deduplicated_union.mechanism: debate is not a default win over simpler multi-path methods
deduplicated_union.distinct_decision_implication: Do not add debate rounds by default; compare one bounded challenge against a simpler baseline.

deduplicated_union.mechanism: simpler structured workflows can perform competitively on benchmark repair
deduplicated_union.distinct_decision_implication: Core pipeline/result are supported; one external-validity clause depends on post-limit evidence.

deduplicated_union.mechanism: repository context quality, precision and cost must be evaluated
deduplicated_union.distinct_decision_implication: Treat context retrieval/standing repository instructions as hypotheses; test relevant utility and cost for the actual task.

global_gaps: No source found or checked directly tests Luna/smaller-model repository scouts discovering useful architecture alternatives in a mixed-model workflow.

No reviewed study validates prompt-injection boundaries, expert direct access to decisive sources, timely consequential review, or independent patch acceptance; these remain explicit task constraints.
All three original reports propose matched local comparisons; none ran the proposed experiment.
selection: No winner selected. Terra screening and expert review stages remain outstanding.
